problem.title: Minimum Operations to Sort A String

approaches.title: Classify by sortedness and character extrema
approaches.summary: Determine the minimum operation count from whether the string is already sorted and how its endpoints compare with the other characters. The implementations progressively reformulate these linear-time checks using a frequency bucket and then interior extrema.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Checks sortedness and scans the remaining characters against the first and last characters to classify the required operations.

revisions.commitBody:
- bucket addition prevents vectorisation of the loop
- bucket addition and initalisation also takes up time
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses a frequency bucket to find the overall minimum and maximum characters and their counts, while checking sortedness in the same pass.

revisions.commitBody:
- check len == 2 after sorted for simpler case
- fast .is_sorted() check can early escape
- fold operation can be vectorised
- simplified checks by finding the min and max of [1..len-1]
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Checks sortedness first, then folds over interior characters to obtain their minimum and maximum and applies simplified endpoint comparisons.
